refnamediv.refpurpose: Open a ZIP archive held in a string

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
data
The contents of an existing ZIP archive. The default, an empty string, creates a new archive.
flags
A bitmask of flags, as for ZipArchive::open, for example ZipArchive::CHECKCONS.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns &true; on success or the error code on failure, for example ZipArchive::ER_NOZIP if data is not a ZIP archive.
